description: This file implements the LifecycleManager class for a plugin in the WPEFramework, including initialization, deinitialization, and internal state management.

classes.name: LifecycleManager
classes.description: A class managing the lifecycle of a plugin, including setup, teardown, and state notifications.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the LifecycleManager with a given service, setting up necessary interfaces and state.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters state notifications for the LifecycleManager.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a JSON string with the service name.
